renderPipeline.software: Blender 5.3.0 macOS arm64, downloaded from official download.blender.org release directory
renderPipeline.geometryEdits: None. Original mesh positions, transforms, labels, and geometry are retained in rendered scenes; no invented geometry, decimation, clipping, or section caps.
renderPipeline.displayEdits: Source display materials were replaced with an atlas palette; smooth shading, studio lights, camera framing, typography, and callout leaders were added for the rendered images.
renderPipeline.orientationPolicy: The pinned GLBs provide anatomical node names and source spatial-entity metadata but do not specify a verified camera-side convention. Views are described as oblique; no anterior/posterior or anatomical left/right markers are shown.
renderPipeline.badgeCenters: left x=144, right x=1056; y=318 or 640 sorted by source anchor y within each side

exclusions: The body outline asset is not registered to the organ GLBs and is rendered alone.
No whole-body mesh or organ set is claimed to be a complete human anatomy model.
The selected urinary coverage is kidneys only; ureter and urinary bladder models are not included.
The selected male reproductive HRA coverage does not include testes or penis; the image states this explicitly.
No camera-side convention is verified; the images omit anatomical laterality markers and do not support side-specific questions.
